caption: A field slides past a train window and is clearly visible through the glass.

sa.check: A field slides past a train window.
It is clearly visible through the glass.
The view is from inside a train carriage.

pc.expect: The view moves continuously past the window and stays visible.
pc.fail: The glass is opaque; or the view freezes; or it jumps.

pc.expect: The scene does not vanish or turn into a different scene.
pc.fail: The field vanishes; or a different landscape appears abruptly; or the view is a static picture.

pc.expect: The view slides one way at a steady pace.
pc.fail: It reverses; or speeds up and stops jerkily; or the near and far ground move the wrong way relative to each other.

pc.expect: The pane is flat and rigid.
pc.fail: It ripples; or bends; or goes opaque.
A second window appears; or the frame vanishes; or the field passes into the carriage.

pc.expect: The carriage interior stays the same.
pc.fail: The seats change; or the frame changes; or the field changes colour abruptly.
